modules.name: Platter
modules.description: Off-centre pressing wow on live audio: a pitch sway locked to the record's rotation (fixed 5 ms latency), with the wow as 1 V/oct CV

modules.name: Inner Groove
modules.description: Needle position from the outer edge to the label: tracing loss, tracing distortion and mistracking, with PLAY to sweep a whole side. No latency

modules.name: Lathe
modules.description: The cutting room: hot cut, elliptic (mono bass) filter, HF limiter and groove echo from neighbouring grooves, clock-syncable. No latency

modules.name: RIAA Sandwich
modules.description: Record EQ curves (RIAA, Columbia, NAB, Decca FFRR, AES) wrapped around a send/return or built-in drive; mismatched curves tilt the tone. No latency

modules.name: Trainwreck
modules.description: Two live decks that never quite stay beatmatched: drift, DJ nudges and flams inside a 100 ms window

modules.name: Stylus
modules.description: Cartridge physics: MM load resonance or MC, crosstalk, azimuth lean and vertical mistracking. Under 0.2 ms latency

modules.name: Pressing
modules.description: Two macros: GENERATION (lacquer to late pressing) and WEAR (a dubplate played to death). No latency

modules.name: Scratch
modules.description: 8-step scratch-gesture sequencer: live audio passes through untouched, gesture steps scratch the audio from a few steps ago
